references.text: Israel is God's treasured possession, a chosen people among all the peoples of the earth, a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.
The Lord brought you out of Egypt so that you would be his treasured possession, his inheritance.
Israel is the Lord's people and his inheritance, whom he brought out with great power.
Blessed is the people the Lord has chosen to be his own inheritance.
God chose David to shepherd Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.
The Lord has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel as his treasured possession.
Jacob's portion is not like these idols, for he is the one who created all things, and Israel is his tribal inheritance.
The Lord will take Judah as his own inheritance in the holy land and choose Jerusalem again.
Christians are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people belonging to God.
Christ gave himself for us to redeem us from all wickedness and to purify for himself a people that are his very own.
In Christ we have received an inheritance, having been predestined according to his plan who works out everything in conformity with the purpose of his will.
